goal: Prevent valid unconfirmed transactions with BIP68 locktimes from being wrongly evicted from the mempool after a reorg
Stops wallets and exchanges relying on mempool persistence from losing transactions and needing to rebroadcast
reviewability: Ready: all raised concerns were addressed and the PR has a re-ACK on the final commit
No open material questions remain, safe to review now
agreement: Strong support after a member identified a real correctness gap and the author adopted the fix (ismaelsadeeq)
Verified by testing the regression against master (Bortlesboat)

categories.name: mempool
why: P2 because it fixes a confirmed bug causing wrongful eviction of valid transactions after routine reorgs
Affects wallets and second-layer protocols that assume mempool persistence, forcing unnecessary rebroadcasts
Similar in kind and severity to the previously merged TRUC reorg fix
